metadata.description: Log your everyday expenses: food, groceries, leisure, bills and rent.

moved.title: Tarja has moved
moved.reinstall: If you installed it on your device, please uninstall it and install it again from the new address.

form.title: Add an expense
form.installmentsOption: {count, plural, one {In one payment} other {In # monthly payments}}
form.chargeDateInvalid: It can't be charged before the day of the expense.
form.personalInvalid: Enter an amount, or leave it empty if it was all yours.
form.personalOver: Your part can't be more than the amount.
form.partInvalid: Each payment needs an amount above zero.
form.saveFailed: Couldn't save the expense on this device. Try again.

list.title: Expenses
list.editIncomplete: Not every payment of this plan is on this device yet, so it can't be edited or duplicated.

sync.offline: You're offline. Your changes are saved on this device.
sync.pending: {count, plural, one {# change waiting to sync} other {# changes waiting to sync}}
sync.rejected: {count, plural, one {# expense couldn't be saved and was discarded.} other {# expenses couldn't be saved and were discarded.}}

auth.title: Sign in to Tarja
auth.description: Your expenses stay with your account, on every device you use.
auth.unreachable: Can't reach Tarja. Check your connection and try again.
auth.failed: Couldn't sign you in. Try again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.label: Nickname
profile.hint: Your friends see this name. It doesn't have to be unique. Until you set one, they see the name of your Google account, {name}.
profile.offline: You're offline. Connect to change your nickname.
profile.invalid: Your nickname needs at least one character that shows.
profile.saveFailed: Couldn't save your nickname. Try again.
profile.removeFailed: Couldn't remove your nickname. Try again.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Create your own categories to sort your expenses, and pick their color and icon.

data.title: Your data
data.description: Download a copy of your data: everything in a JSON file, or just the expenses in a CSV file that opens in a spreadsheet. They are made on this device, so they work offline.

account.title: Account
account.signOutFailed: Couldn't sign out. Signing out needs a connection.
account.unsynced: Some expenses haven't synced yet. They stay on this device until you sign in again.

categoryManager.title: Categories
categoryManager.offline: You're offline. Connect to change your categories.
categoryManager.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? Its expenses will show as {fallback}.
categoryManager.nameTaken: You already have a category with that name.
categoryManager.saveFailed: Couldn't save the category. Try again.
categoryManager.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete the category. Try again.

groups.title: Groups

settle.title: Settle up
settle.same: From and To have to be two different people.

share.none: You have no groups or friends yet. Make one in Groups to share an expense.

group.missing: This group isn't here. It doesn't exist, or you're not in it.
group.loadFailed: Couldn't load your groups. Connect to see them.
group.entriesFailed: Couldn't load the expenses of this group. Connect to see them.

closed.deleted: This group was deleted. Its expenses stay as they were.
closed.deletedFriend: This friend was removed. What you shared stays as it was.
closed.left: You left this group. It stays as it was the day you left.

groups.offline: You're offline. Connect to make or change a group.
groups.empty: You have no groups or friends yet.
groups.totalsWait: Couldn't load the expenses of every group, so there are no totals yet. Connect to see them.

new.title: New group
new.name: Name
new.personHint: By name, one at a time. They don't need the app.
new.full: A group takes {max} people at most, you included.

friend.title: Add a friend
friend.name: Their name
friend.nameHint: By name. They don't need the app.

groups.nameInvalid: Write a name with at least one character that shows.

failure.offline: You're offline. Connect and try again.
failure.readOnly: This group is closed, so nothing in it can change.
failure.unsynced: Some of your changes to this group haven't been sent yet. Connect and try again.
failure.unsettled: This person's balance isn't zero. Settle up first.
failure.notOwner: Only the owner of the group can do that.
failure.ownerLeaves: The owner can't leave. Make someone else the owner first, or delete the group.
failure.memberGone: That person is no longer in the group.
failure.notAUser: The person you chose hasn't joined the app yet.
failure.notPlaceholder: That person has joined already, so they can't be merged or replaced.
failure.tooManyGroups: You're in {max} open groups, the most there can be. Leave or delete one first.
failure.tooManyFriends: You have {max} friends, the most there can be. Remove one first.
failure.friendTooManyGroups: That friend is in {max} open groups, the most there can be.
failure.alreadyMember: That friend is in the group already, or was in it before.
failure.unknownFriend: That person is no longer your friend.
failure.tooManyMembers: This group has {max} people, the most it can have.
failure.failed: Couldn't save the change. Try again.

edit.title: Edit {name}
edit.showHint: When it's off, this group's expenses are not in your list, summary, charts or budgets.
edit.name: Name

people.title: People
people.mergeQuestion: Merge {name} into someone who uses the app? What was split with {name} becomes theirs. This can't be undone.
people.makeOwnerQuestion: Make {name} the owner? You stay in the group, and only they can do what the owner does.
people.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from the group? They stay in the expenses already shared.
people.unsettled: {name}'s balance isn't zero. Settle up first.
people.addHint: By name. They don't need the app.

leave.question: Leave {name}?
leave.what: The group closes for you as it is today. Its expenses stay in your list, and you can turn them off here.
leave.unsettled: Your balance in {name} isn't zero. Settle up before you leave.

delete.question: Delete {name}?
delete.what: The group closes for everybody in it. The expenses stay in your list, and you can turn them off here.
delete.unsettled: Not every balance in {name} is zero. Settle up before you delete it.

deleteFriend.question: Remove {name} from your friends?
deleteFriend.what: What you shared stays as it was. It stays in your list, and you can turn it off here.
deleteFriend.unsettled: You and {name} aren't settled. Settle up before you remove them.

summary.title: Summary
summary.leftHint: Set the income of this month to see what is left.
summary.offline: You're offline. Connect to change your income.

form.label: Income of {month}
form.saveFailed: Couldn't save the income. Try again.
form.removeFailed: Couldn't remove the income. Try again.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.hint: A limit holds for the following months until one sets another. Leave a field empty, or type 0, for no limit from this month on.
budgets.invalid: Enter an amount, or leave it empty for no limit.
budgets.saveFailed: Couldn't save the limits. Try again.
budgets.offline: You're offline. Connect to change your limits.

warning.near: {name} of {month} is at {percent} % of its limit
warning.nearTotal: The total of {month} is at {percent} % of its limit
warning.overTotal: The total of {month} went over its limit

charts.title: Charts
charts.rangeInvalid: The start can't be after the end.
charts.rangeTooLong: Too many rows to draw. Pick fewer dates, or group by week or month.
charts.readoutHint: Tap a column, or use the arrow keys, to read its amount.
charts.chartSpan: {granularity, select, day {{count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}} week {{count, plural, one {# week} other {# weeks}}} other {{count, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}}}
charts.noPrevious: Nothing spent in the previous period ({period}) to compare with.
charts.noPreviousSoFar: {current} vs. {period}: nothing spent in the days before.
